Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 40 (Equinix missing-address campaign): added a DataCenterMap sourced address after reconfirming the operators own DC17 page still 404s, research_status remains complete.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] Equinix operates a very large global portfolio and this session found its own per-building pages under equinix.com/data-centers/ to be inconsistently populated: some individual IBX codes 404 entirely (confirmed fresh this session for DC17), and others that do load, such as DC7, checked fresh this session, still omit street address and square footage, deferring that detail to a downloadable specification sheet not reachable by this research pass. Given this, addresses in this batch rely on aggregator sourcing, preferring cases with independent multi source agreement, per this registrys standard source hierarchy. This specific row, DC17, on the Ashburn/Washington DC metro campus. The operators own individual DC17 page returned a 404 error on both a prior research pass and a fresh check this session. DataCenterMap independently gives this facility as 44710 Performance Cir, Ashburn, VA, and Baxtel maintains its own dedicated DC17 page confirming the facility is tracked as a distinct entity, though this session did not extract a street address from the Baxtel page itself.
sources_tried: Equinix own Washington DC metro index page and a fresh direct fetch of the individual DC17 page confirming a 404, a DataCenterMap listing specific to this building, and confirmation that Baxtel tracks it as a distinct facility
profile.regional_context: Per Equinix's own site, this 15-facility metro region is positioned as the largest peering point in North America and a major communications gateway to Europe. DataCenterDynamics has separately covered Culpeper County's emergence as a newer extension of the Ashburn data center corridor.
profile.facility_type_note: Part of Equinix's Washington DC metro campus, Equinix's largest single metro by facility count, spanning Ashburn (DC1-DC6, DC10-DC13, DC15-DC16, DC21-DC22), Manassas (DC14), and Culpeper.
